methodology.selection: Top eight products by units before validation, with at least 60 selling days.
methodology.evaluation: Four weekly forecast origins in validation, then four in untouched holdout. Each origin uses only earlier observations.
methodology.range: The selected model's 80th-percentile absolute validation error. This is an empirical range, not a guaranteed confidence interval.
limitations: These are observed orders, not unconstrained demand; stockouts and opening hours are unknown.
C-prefixed negative invoice lines are cancellation proxies, not verified physical returns.
Identical invoice lines are retained because no unique line identifier proves they are duplicates.
The final extract date is excluded conservatively because it may be incomplete.
This historical retailer supplies some wholesale customers; bulk orders and seasonal changes can defeat either forecast.
